messages:
Aisha: Heads-up — POC with MediCore stuck. They report SAML login error 'NameID not found' and SCIM provisioning returns 403. Need presales help to unblock before EOW.
Carlos: Which environment are they using? Hosted or Dedicated?
Aisha: Dedicated. Tenant ID `medicore-77`. They tried provisioning via Azure AD.
Ben: NameID missing usually means attribute mapping in Azure AD app is wrong or NameID format mismatch. Do we expect `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress`?
Marta: Our SP expects persistent NameID or email depending on tenant settings. For Dedicated we require NameID to be `emailAddress` by default. Also check the App Manifest in Azure AD for `replyUrls` / AssertionConsumerService.
Aisha: They sent a screenshot of the Azure AD claims: they only map `user.mail` to `email` and no NameIdentifier mapping.
Carlos: Ok, ask them to add a claim: NameIdentifier -> user.userprincipalname (set format Email Address). In the Enterprise App > Single sign-on > Attributes & Claims.
Ben: For SCIM 403, our gateway shows `403 invalid scim scope` and `401 missing x-tenant-id` intermittently. Could be their SCIM client not setting `X-Tenant-ID` or our gateway stripping it when proxied.
Marta: Reminder: Dedicated SCIM endpoints require both `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `X-Tenant-ID: medicore-77`. Some off-the-shelf SCIM apps (Azure's provisioning service) need custom header passthrough configured in the provisioning connector.
Aisha: The customer says Azure provisioning UI has no place to add custom headers. They are using the built-in Azure AD provisioning connector.
Carlos: Two options: 1) Use our SCIM proxy URL that embeds tenant in path (we also accept tenant path which avoids header in some setups) — e.g. `https://api.redwood-inference.com/dedicated/medicore-77/scim/v2/Users` 2) If that still fails, use a tiny proxy in their network to add X-Tenant-ID header.
Ben: I'll paste a curl check they can run from a shell to validate token + path: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" https://api.redwood-inference.com/dedicated/medicore-77/scim/v2/Users
```
Marta: Also confirm the token scope — provisioning token must include `scim:write` for user create/replace operations. If token lacks scope we return 403 with `invalid scope`.
Aisha: They ran the curl and got 403 with body `{"error":"invalid_scope"}`. They rotated token and tried again same result.
Carlos: That means the token issued to their tenant didn't include the scim scope. Jenna or security needs to re-issue with correct scope. Marta, can you confirm we can issue a POC-scoped token?
Marta: Security approved short-lived POC tokens with corrected scopes. I'll generate one for `medicore-77` (expires 12h) and mark it for provisioning only.
Ben: On the SAML side, they updated Azure claim mapping to emit NameID as `user.mail` and set NameID format to `emailAddress`. They still see Audience mismatch: `audience mismatch: expected https://dedicated.prod.redwood-inference.com/medicore-77 but got https://app.medicore.example.com`.
Aisha: That suggests they registered our SP metadata incorrectly. They likely uploaded their SP into our console. They need to download our SP metadata and upload it into Azure as the SP.
Carlos: Quick checklist to send the customer: 1) Ensure Azure app has our SP EntityID/ACS. 2) Add NameIdentifier claim -> user.mail with Email Address format. 3) Use SCIM base path with tenant in URL or ensure custom header passthrough. 4) Use provisioning token with `scim:write` scope.
Aisha: I'll DM their infra lead with the checklist and attach the temporary token when Marta posts it.
Marta: Token created: `scim-poc-abc123` (expires in 12h). I also added note about IP allowlist if they hit blocked responses.
deploy-bot: created ephemeral hosted fallback tenant `tenant-hosted-mc123` and attached a hosted-scim token valid 24h in case Dedicated reconfig takes longer.
Carlos: Good fallback. If Azure's provisioning can't add custom headers, they can use the hosted tenant for demo and switch to Dedicated later.
Aisha: Customer confirmed they can try hosted fallback for immediate signoff. Thanks team, will update once they finish the test :raised_hands:
